sourcesScraped: DEA Special Testing and Research Laboratory

alerts.summary: Medetomidine and Xylazine Adulterant Infiltration in Illicit Street Opioids
alerts.details: Non-opioid alpha-2 adrenergic agonists detected in seized heroin powders across regional transit hubs. Induces severe necrotic ulcerations and profound hypotension; unresponsive to naloxone.

reagentGuidance.expectedReaction: No direct Marquis color change; Marquis detects base opioid while adulterant remains masked
reagentGuidance.cautionNote: Alpha-2 agonist not reversed by naloxone. Use dedicated test strip.

alerts.summary: Protonitazepyne and Bromazolam Adulteration in Counterfeit Prescription Tablets
alerts.details: Severe synthetic benzimidazole opioid analogue with estimated potency up to 20x fentanyl identified in counterfeit prescription pills.

reagentGuidance.expectedReaction: Yellow-brown delayed reaction (reagent does not confirm nitazene; test strip required)
reagentGuidance.cautionNote: High potency synthetic opioid (up to 20-40x fentanyl). Presumptive only.

alerts.summary: Morphine Sulfate Oral Solution 20 mg/mL - Subpotency and Microbial Contamination
alerts.details: Class I recall initiated due to out-of-specification microbial testing and degradation of active pharmaceutical ingredient.

reagentGuidance.cautionNote: Standard forensic presumptive spot test. Observe within 10-30 seconds.

alerts.summary: Counterfeit Alprazolam 2mg Tablets Pressed with Unregulated Bromazolam
alerts.details: Counterfeit blister packs mimicking licensed pharmaceutical brands found to contain unregulated bromazolam rather than alprazolam. Extreme sedation risk.

reagentGuidance.expectedReaction: Faint grey-brown to no reaction with Marquis; purple-violet with Zimmerman reagent
reagentGuidance.cautionNote: Reagent reaction frequently masked by excipients in pressed counterfeit tablets.

alerts.summary: Trace Detection of Ultra-Potent Fentanyl and Nitazene Analogues in Seized Powder Shipments
alerts.details: High-lethality synthetic opioids identified in cross-border consignments. Severe dermal and inhalation hazard to first-response field officers.

reagentGuidance.cautionNote: Standard forensic presumptive spot test. Observe within 10-30 seconds.

alerts.summary: Counterfeit Mixed Amphetamine Salts (Adderall 30mg) Pressed with Methamphetamine
alerts.details: Class I recall of illicit counterfeit tablets mimicking Adderall 30mg found circulating in unauthorized retail channels containing methamphetamine.

reagentGuidance.cautionNote: Standard forensic presumptive spot test. Observe within 10-30 seconds.
